semantics: Use exactly the stopped V42 independent sealed prefix; unknown boundaries/ACK/service are excluded from these cohorts, not called failures.
Last ACK is reconstructed from the original event's service timestamp and last-ACK-to-service interval.
The four timestamp differences reconcile for each fully observed event; distribution quantiles are not additive.
ACK-to-completion is signed and may be negative for a post-boundary ACK. This is an algebraic timestamp decomposition, not nonoverlapping CPU/GPU cost attribution.
A long pre-completion ACK lead is early residency, not queue admission delay. It can still have capacity and premature-prefetch costs.
Native arrival to first service includes restoration, capacity and scheduling, not a localized scheduler function cost.
The early-FULL cohort retains the original proof of pre-completion submission and following-request reuse; it does not prove native-relative throughput savings.
